note: Banco Basa's tariff report for October 2026: its Classic Mastercard or Visa costs 264,000 guaraníes a year, and loans by credit card bear a nominal 18.05% a year (19.62% effective). The interest is subject to VAT, at a rate the report doesn't state, so it isn't added.

sources.title: Banco Basa, Informe de tarifas para el mes de octubre de 2026
sources.said: INFORME DE TARIFAS PARA EL MES DE OCTUBRE DE 2026 ... * PRÉSTAMOS POR TARJETAS DE CRÉDITO - 18,05% 18,05% 19,62% 19,62% ... Mastercard / Visa / Clásica - Principal. 264.000 N/A Anual.
